socfpga_interrupt.h

GIC hardware abstraction driver interface for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

Constants
interrupt_min_interrupt_priority

Defines the minimum allowed software-defined priority level for interrupts within the SoC FPGA environment.

MAX_SPI_HPU_INTERRUPT

The upper boundary of the SPI (Shared Peripheral Interrupt) identifier range supported by the hardware.

SOCFPGA_DEFAULT_INTERRUPT_SPIN

Selects the driver's default wait behavior for interrupt handling. When defined, the driver uses a busy-wait (spin) loop while servicing or polling interrupt state instead of yielding or sleeping.

SOCFPGA_PPI_START

The first valid INTID of the Private Peripheral Interrupt (PPI) range. PPIs are per-core interrupts delivered through the Redistributor.

SOCFPGA_MAX_PPI

The last valid INTID of the Private Peripheral Interrupt (PPI) range, marking the inclusive upper bound used for PPI ID validation.

SOCFPGA_SPI_START

The first valid INTID of the Shared Peripheral Interrupt (SPI) range. Aliases <SDM_APS_MAILBOX_INTR>, the lowest SPI routed to the GIC Distributor.

SOCFPGA_MAX_SPI

The last valid INTID of the Shared Peripheral Interrupt (SPI) range. Aliases <MAX_HPU_SPI_INTERRUPT>, the inclusive upper bound used for SPI ID validation.

Types
socfpga_hpu_interrupt_t

A comprehensive map of hardware interrupt identifiers (INTIDs) for the SoCFPGA SoC. These values represent the physical signals from IP blocks (SDM, EMAC, DMA, etc.) that are routed to the GIC distributor.

socfpga_interrupt_callback_t

Function signature for user-defined ISR handlers registered through the driver.

Parameters
data

An opaque pointer provided by the user during registration, passed directly to the callback when the interrupt fires.

socfpga_hpu_interrupt_type_t

Specifies the hardware trigger sensitivity for a peripheral interrupt.

socfpga_hpu_spi_interrupt_mode_t

Defines the routing behavior for SPIs (Shared Peripheral Interrupts).

socfpga_interrupt_err_t

Standard status codes returned by GIC management functions to indicate configuration or registration errors.

interrupt_init_gic
void interrupt_init_gic(
void
)

Performs hardware-level initialization of the GIC Distributor and Redistributor logic. This includes enabling Group 0 and Group 1 interrupt delivery and configuring global interrupt security settings.

gic_default_interrupt_handler
void gic_default_interrupt_handler(
void 
*
data
)

The fallback ISR triggered for unexpected or unhandled interrupts. This usually halts the system or logs a fatal error depending on the debug level.

Parameters
data
void*

Pointer to context-specific information or NULL.
